title: The launch flopped and the team wants to quit
situation: Your team of five spent two months building a free app that helps students swap textbooks on campus. Launch week is over: forty downloads, three swaps, and one review calling it "confusing". At tonight's team meeting Madina, the designer, says it is time to shut it down.
yourRole: You started the project and you lead it.
goal: Decide with the team what happens next. There is no single right way to do it.

character.name: Madina
character.wants: To stop spending evenings on something nobody uses

hiddenMotive: She thinks the confusing screens are her fault and would rather quit than hear it said.

beats.goal: Madina proposes shutting the app down.

examples: That's a fair point. What makes you think we should stop?
I hear you. Tell me what's been hardest this week.
Okay, before anyone decides, I want to hear how you see it.
answerTypes.characterIntent: says the week has been exhausting and she doesn't see the point anymore.

examples: No way, we're not quitting.
We didn't work two months to give up now.

answerTypes.characterIntent: shrugs and asks what the numbers are supposed to mean then.
